description_en: This topic describes the syntax and provides examples of the DetectLymph operation
description_zh: 本文介绍淋巴结检测DetectLymph的语法及示例
name: DetectLymph

fields.help_en:
The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) URL in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.

N in URLList.N.URL indicates the sequence number of the image URL in the current list (starting from 1). When you directly use the API, specify the URLList parameters in the format of URLList.1.URL=url1, URLList.2.URL=url2, and so on. Separate parameter pairs with ampersands (&). Replace url1, url2, and other values with actual values. When you use an SDK, use the corresponding methods provided by the SDK to populate the URLList
fields.help_zh:
图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。

URLList.N.URL中的N为该图像URL在当前List中的顺序（从1开始）。当直接使用API请求时，输入URLList的填充会以URLList.1.URL=url1，URLList.2.URL=url2，......的方式指定参数和参数值，参数对以&连接，其中url1、url2、......等具体值请根据实际情况进行替换；当使用SDK填充URLList时，可直接使用SDK提供的相应的方法
fields.name: url

parameters.help_en: The type of the input data. Only `HTTP_FILES` is supported
parameters.help_zh: 输入数据的类型，仅支持`HTTP_FILES`
parameters.name: data_source_type

Data.description_en: The returned data. After the asynchronous task is executed successfully, call the [GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html） operation and perform JSON deserialization on the Result field to obtain this data
Data.description_zh: 返回的结果数据内容。该数据需要在异步任务执行成功后，通过调用[GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html）接口，对其Result字段进行JSON反序列化之后得到

Boxes.description_en: The 3D bounding box coordinates of the lesion (X1, Y1, Z1, X2, Y2, Z2)

items.description_en: The 3D bounding box coordinates of the lesion (X1, Y1, Z1, X2, Y2, Z2)

Diametermm.description_en: The long and short axis lengths, in millimeters
Diametermm.description_zh: 长径和短径长度，单位：毫米

items.description_en:
The long and short axis lengths, in millimeters.

We recommend that you set a short axis threshold, such as 7 mm, to filter out lesions with excessively small short axes
items.description_zh:
长径和短径长度，单位：毫米。

使用时建议设置一个短径阈值，例如7毫米，过滤掉短径过小的病灶

KeySlice.description_en:
The key slice.

The key slice is the axial slice where the short axis of the lesion is the longest
KeySlice.description_zh:
关键帧。

关键帧为病灶短径最大的横轴位切面

Recist.description_en: The Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST), which uses long and short axis diameters to evaluate treatment response
Recist.description_zh: 实体肿瘤疗效评价标准，即利用长短径来评判疗效

items.description_en: The Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST), which uses long and short axis diameters to evaluate treatment response
items.description_zh: 实体肿瘤疗效评价标准，即利用长短径来评判疗效

items.description_en: 长短径起止点坐标（X1,Y1,X2,Y2,X3,Y3,X4,Y4）。（X1,Y1）和（X2,Y2）确定长径，（X3,Y3）和（X4,Y4）确定短径
items.description_zh: 长短径起止点坐标（X1,Y1,X2,Y2,X3,Y3,X4,Y4）。（X1,Y1）和（X2,Y2）确定长径，（X3,Y3）和（X4,Y4）确定短径

Score.description_en:
The confidence score. Valid values: 0 to 1.

We recommend that you use data with a confidence score greater than 0.5
Score.description_zh:
置信度，取值范围0~1。

使用时建议选择置信度大于0.5的数据

Message.description_en: The message returned after the asynchronous task is submitted
Message.description_zh: 提交异步任务后的提示信息
Message.example: 该调用为异步调用，任务已提交成功，请以requestId的值作为jobId参数调用同类目下GetAsyncJobResult接口查询任务执行状态和结果。
